items.name: slash-menu
items.title: Slash Menu
items.description: Command-palette surface for the '/' block-insert menu: shadcn Command inside an anchored Popover, driven by useSlashMenu.

items.name: bubble-toolbar
items.title: Bubble Toolbar
items.description: Selection-anchored inline formatting toolbar (bold/italic/strike/code) rendered in a Popover, driven by useBubbleToolbar.

items.name: block-handle
items.title: Block Handle
items.description: Gutter overlay: hover handle for insert-below/drag/click grip, drop indicator, and the block context menu. Requires a TooltipProvider ancestor.

items.name: mention-menu
items.title: Mention Menu
items.description: Async '@'-mention search surface: shadcn Command inside a Popover, driven by useMention.

items.name: emoji-menu
items.title: Emoji Menu
items.description: ':shortcode:' emoji picker: shadcn Command inside a Popover, driven by useEmoji.

items.name: link-editor-popover
items.title: Link Editor Popover
items.description: Inline link create/edit popover: href input plus open/remove actions, driven by useLinkEditor.

items.name: comment-panel
items.description: Sidebar comment surface reading thread data from the CommentThreadStore configured on the editor.

items.name: comment-composer
items.title: Comment Composer
items.description: Selection-anchored comment composer backed by the editor's configured CommentThreadStore.

items.name: icons
items.title: Slash Editor Icons
items.description: Shared icon-key resolver with a visible fallback icon.

items.name: presence-avatars
items.title: Presence Avatars
items.description: Row of colored initials for connected collaborators, driven by usePresence against any awareness-shaped provider.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: Heading outline of the live document: the active row tracks the caret or scroll position, driven by useTableOfContents.

items.name: node-views
items.title: Media & AI Node Views
items.description: ReactNodeViewRenderer targets for image/file/video (shared upload/retry chrome, adapter passed as a prop — never a hardcoded mock), embed, and aiBlock. Wire with `<Type>.extend({ addNodeView: () => ReactNodeViewRenderer((props) => <XNodeView {...props} adapter={yourAdapter} />) })`.

items.name: mermaid-node-view
items.title: Mermaid Node View
items.description: ReactNodeViewRenderer target for the core `mermaid` node: rendered diagram by default, source plus live preview while the caret is inside. Themed from your shadcn tokens; `mermaid` is lazy-loaded on first render. Wire with `Mermaid.extend({ addNodeView: () => ReactNodeViewRenderer(MermaidNodeView) })` and `blockKit: { mermaid: false }`.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover (anchor-aware)
items.description: shadcn Popover with an `anchor` prop forwarded to the Positioner, so a surface can anchor to the caret or a block's rect instead of a trigger element.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu (anchor-aware)
items.description: shadcn Dropdown Menu with an `anchor` prop forwarded to the Positioner, for the same reason as the anchor-aware Popover. Overrides the default shadcn `dropdown-menu`.

items.name: slash-editor-kit
items.title: slash-editor Kit
items.description: Every slash-editor UI piece in one install: slash menu, bubble toolbar, block handle, mention menu, emoji menu, link editor, comment panel, presence avatars, the table of contents, media/AI node views, and the Mermaid node view.
